method: Same selection system as live play: random subjects and formats, then random unseen questions. Recent subjects are avoided to keep the mix varied; first 100.

questions.prompt: Name a Legendary or Mythical Pokémon.
questions.scope: Species classified as Legendary or Mythical in the pinned PokéAPI data count. Forms share their species' answer identity. Pseudo-Legendary is a fan label and does not make a species Legendary.

questions.prompt: Name a musician known for playing drums.
questions.scope: Real musicians known for playing drums count, including multi-instrumentalists and percussionists with a documented drum-playing career. An unrelated band member does not become a drummer just because the band has one.

questions.prompt: Name a wild animal in the dog family.
questions.scope: Living and recently extinct species in the Mammal Diversity Database, plus established named animal groups, count. English names, documented scientific names and genuine public synonyms count. Prehistoric fossil-only species are outside this current-species inventory. Domestic dog breeds do not count. Dingoes and New Guinea singing dogs count as established wild-dog groups; their disputed species rank does not make their names invalid.

questions.prompt: Name a type of rock.
questions.scope: Recognized geological rock names, rock families and established natural stone varieties count. Common and scientific rock names are accepted. Individual minerals, chemical elements, whole mountains and manufactured building products are not rock types.

questions.prompt: Name something people open using a key or a code.
questions.scope: Physical objects and devices count; the code can be a password or combination.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of flatbread.
questions.scope: Recognized flatbread types, named regional breads and flatbread dishes count, including leavened and unleavened types. Ordinary sandwich loaves, toppings and ingredients alone do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a type of paint.
questions.scope: Types of paint defined by medium, finish or purpose count, including artist and building paints. Color names alone, a layer of paint and digital painting software do not.

questions.prompt: Name a player who has played for the Indiana Pacers.
questions.scope: At least one first-team NBA, BAA or ABA game for this franchise counts, past or present. Coaches, draft rights and preseason-only appearances do not.

questions.prompt: Name a song by Beyoncé.
questions.scope: Released recordings credited to Beyoncé count, including collaborations, features and released covers. Writing or production credit alone does not count. Different versions share one answer.

questions.prompt: Name an enchantment in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Base-game and recorded expansion names count. Versions of the same named object count once.

questions.prompt: Name a wild animal that spends time both in water and on land.
questions.scope: The animal must normally use both habitats, not merely survive a brief swim.

questions.prompt: Name an item or product used to wash, dry or care for laundry.
questions.scope: Laundry appliances, supplies, stain treatments and clothes-care tools count, as do named product types and established laundry-product brands, including historical ones. A garment itself is not a laundry supply.

questions.prompt: Name a coffee drink or established coffee preparation.
Name a real valley, canyon or gorge.
questions.scope: Real named valleys, canyons and gorges on Earth count. Features conventionally known by these names count, including Bryce Canyon. Fictional places and a whole country alone do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a material or substance used to make things.
Name a sitcom.
questions.scope: Live-action and animated situation comedies count; sketch-only shows do not.

questions.prompt: Name a type of sports equipment.
Name an item that restores health in a video game.
questions.scope: Named consumables, pickups and healing items count; name the actual item.

questions.prompt: Name a piece of camping equipment.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a named dish or preparation in which eggs are a main ingredient.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name an artist associated with metal music.
Name a weather event or weather condition.
questions.scope: Common and established technical names count; fictional weather does not.

questions.prompt: Name a comedy movie.
Name a type of ball used in a sport, game or athletic training.
questions.scope: Named balls used in sports, games or athletic training count, including particular game-ball designs. Pucks, shuttlecocks and punching bags are not balls.

questions.prompt: Name a flower or flowering block found in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Flower items and blocks count, including tall flowers and Nether-compatible flowers. Named crops and saplings do not become flowers merely because they are plants. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

questions.prompt: Name a type of tower.
questions.scope: Types of built tower count, including towers defined by their function or structure. Individual named towers do not.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of marsupial. Named groups and species, living or extinct, count; a common or scientific name is accepted.
questions.scope: Types, named examples and established synonyms count. This is a finite source inventory.

questions.prompt: Name a type of footwear.
Name a guitar manufacturer or established guitar brand, including historical makers.
questions.scope: Types, named examples and established synonyms count. This is a finite source inventory.

questions.prompt: Name a tool, instrument or piece of glassware used in a science laboratory.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a water sport or recreational activity on or in water.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Building”.
Name a named vehicle from fiction.
questions.scope: Named fictional vehicles, ships and vehicle models count across film, TV, books, comics and games, including living vehicle characters. Generic words such as car or spaceship, and individual parts that are not vehicles, do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of animal that can regrow a lost body part.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name an object that commonly has a hinge.
questions.scope: A common hinged version of the object must exist. Sliding or roll-up versions do not prevent a genuinely hinged object from counting.

questions.prompt: Name a musical artist or band with a number in their name.
questions.scope: Numbers written as digits, words or Roman numerals count.

questions.prompt: Name a city that has hosted the modern Olympics.
questions.scope: Summer and Winter hosts count; ancient host cities alone do not.

questions.prompt: Name a driver who has competed in Formula One.
questions.scope: Drivers in the complete Jolpica/Ergast Formula One World Championship driver inventory count, including historical entrants and the Indianapolis 500 when it was part of that championship. A real surname can identify a valid driver; invented initials and racing three-letter codes do not count as names.

questions.prompt: Name one of the 88 official constellations.
questions.scope: Official IAU constellation names count. Recognized common names such as Capricorn and the Great Bear are accepted. Asterisms such as the Big Dipper are only parts of constellations.

questions.prompt: Name a crime TV or streaming show.
Name an ice-cream topping or mix-in.
questions.scope: Named toppings and mix-ins used on ice cream, gelato or frozen custard count, including candy, fruit, nuts, sauces and cake pieces. A flavor by itself is not a topping.

questions.prompt: Name a type of knife.
questions.scope: Real knife styles and knife-like edged hand tools count, including kitchen, craft, hunting and surgical knives. Medical devices that only use knife metaphorically do not.

questions.prompt: Name an artist associated with rock music.
Name a kind of animal that has a protective shell, carapace, bony plates or body armour.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Racing”.
Name a government-issued currency, monetary unit or named historical coin.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a quarterback who started and won a Super Bowl.
questions.scope: The quarterback must have started a winning Super Bowl, through Super Bowl LX in February 2026. Winning a ring as a backup alone does not count.

questions.prompt: Name a type of custard or a dessert made with custard.
questions.scope: Named custards and desserts made using custard or custard powder count. A cream-only filling does not qualify merely because it is called cream.

questions.prompt: Name a type of furniture or household furnishing.
Name a piece of equipment used to take or process photographs.
questions.scope: Physical equipment, supplies and accessories used in still photography count, including darkroom materials. A finished photograph, filmed sequence or a device used only to mark a film take does not.

questions.prompt: Name a fantasy movie.
Name an item or block a furnace recipe can produce in Minecraft.
questions.scope: Give the output, rather than the input, of an ordinary furnace smelting or cooking recipe. Official Java 26.3 recipe, tag or component data defines the inventory; modded behavior does not count.

questions.prompt: Name a musical instrument with a keyboard.
questions.scope: Recognized keyboard-instrument types and documented named keyboard instruments or models count. Keys and buttons form the musical playing interface; having ordinary valves or attaching an external controller does not automatically qualify another instrument.

questions.prompt: Name a landform, natural feature or kind of landscape.
Name a brand that makes athletic shoes.
questions.scope: Real sports-footwear brands count, including specialist running and court-shoe brands.

questions.prompt: Name an item used for sewing or mending clothes.
questions.scope: Hand-sewing, machine-sewing and dressmaking tools and supplies count. A finished garment alone is not sewing equipment.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of owl.
questions.scope: Owl species and established named groups count, including recently extinct species in the source taxonomy. Common names and scientific names count. An owlet-nightjar or a nighthawk is not an owl.

questions.prompt: Name a human muscle or muscle group.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name something sold as a pizza topping.
questions.scope: Established restaurant toppings count worldwide; you do not need to name a pizza brand.

questions.prompt: Name a playable hero in Dota 2.
questions.scope: The complete official playable hero roster in the October 25, 2026 snapshot counts. Items, cosmetics and non-playable creeps are not heroes.

questions.prompt: Name a song with a color in its title.
questions.scope: Ordinary color words in released song titles count; color names used as surnames need context.

questions.prompt: Name a player who has won the NBA regular-season MVP award.
questions.scope: Winners of the main NBA regular-season Most Valuable Player award through the 2025–26 season count. Finals, All-Star and other leagues' MVP awards are different.

questions.prompt: Name a country whose national flag contains a star.
questions.scope: A visible star on the official national flag qualifies; tiny stars inside a coat of arms count too.

questions.prompt: Name a plant that has thorns, spines or prickles.
questions.scope: The sharp growth can be on any ordinary part of the plant; edible plants count too.

questions.prompt: Name an item used in a bathroom.
questions.scope: Established bathroom, bathing, grooming and hygiene items count.

questions.prompt: Name a villain from a children's animated TV series.
questions.scope: Named antagonists count even if they sometimes help the heroes.

questions.prompt: Name one of the original 151 Pokémon.
questions.scope: The original species names count; you do not need to name a special form.

questions.prompt: Name a percussion instrument.
questions.scope: Types, named examples and established synonyms count. This is a finite source inventory.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete featured on a video game's cover or in its title.
questions.scope: An officially released sports game's cover athlete or title namesake qualifies.

questions.prompt: Name a cloud type, form or recognized cloud feature.
questions.scope: Cloud genera, species, varieties and recognized cloud features count, along with established common names such as lenticular cloud, contrail and fog at ground level. Weather events, precipitation and a blue sky alone do not count.

questions.prompt: Name a river, lake, sea, ocean, gulf, bay or strait.
Name a type of tree.
Name a kind of physical barrier.
questions.scope: Physical barriers such as walls, doors, fences, gates and protective barriers count. Figurative barriers and software do not.

questions.prompt: Name a food that is commonly pickled.
questions.scope: Vegetables, fruits, eggs, meats and seafood with established pickled preparations count. Vinegar and brine are ingredients, not foods being pickled.

questions.prompt: Name an outfit from Fortnite.
questions.scope: Any recorded season or collaboration counts. These are cosmetic names, not Battle Royale weapon names.

questions.prompt: Name a song by Imagine Dragons.
questions.scope: Released recordings credited to Imagine Dragons count, including collaborations, features and released covers. Writing or production credit alone does not count. Different versions share one answer.

questions.prompt: Name a horror movie.
Name a player who has played for the Toronto Raptors.
questions.scope: At least one first-team NBA, BAA or ABA game for this franchise counts, past or present. Coaches, draft rights and preseason-only appearances do not.

questions.prompt: Name an audio listening, recording or amplification device.
questions.scope: Physical devices for listening to, picking up, recording, reproducing or amplifying audio count. Musical instruments by themselves, warning bells and noise-suppression-only devices do not.

questions.prompt: Name a type of shop.
Name a real named dam.
questions.scope: Named real dams and barrages count, including historical dams and named projects already under construction. A reservoir name does not automatically name its dam, and fictional dams do not count.

questions.prompt: Name an insect.
questions.scope: Established types and named examples count. Alternate standard names are the same answer.

questions.prompt: Name a game on Steam tagged “Survival”.
Name a stringed musical instrument.
questions.scope: Types, named examples and established synonyms count. This is a finite source inventory.

questions.prompt: Name someone who has played Major League Baseball (through 2025).
Name a chemical element. Symbols count.
Name a kind of box or boxed storage container.
questions.scope: Types of physical box, chest, crate and boxed storage container count, including cases with a recognizable box form. Metaphorical boxes and software do not.

questions.prompt: Name a princess from fiction.
questions.scope: Characters who are, were, or are explicitly known as princesses count, along with the official Disney Princess lineup. A character does not qualify simply by being female, wearing a crown or appearing in a Disney movie.

questions.prompt: Name a kind of whale, dolphin or porpoise.
questions.scope: Living and recently extinct species in the Mammal Diversity Database, plus established named animal groups, count. English names, documented scientific names and genuine public synonyms count. Prehistoric fossil-only species are outside this current-species inventory.

questions.prompt: Name a corn-based food or drink.
questions.scope: Corn or cornmeal must be a defining ingredient. Foods, drinks and edible corn products count; incidental corn-derived additives do not make every food corn-based.

questions.prompt: Name a volcano or named volcanic complex. Dormant and extinct ones count.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name an athlete who has played professionally in a team sport.
questions.scope: Men's and women's sports, any country and any era count; no roster-year restriction.

questions.prompt: Name an artist associated with pop music.
Name an object designed to be inflated.
questions.scope: Common inflatable objects and named inflatable equipment types count, whether filled with air, helium or another gas. Objects merely containing an empty cavity do not qualify.

questions.prompt: Name a video game where you can drive a car or kart.
questions.scope: The driving must be part of the unmodded game, not a fan modification.

questions.prompt: Name an anime TV or streaming show.
Name a bird that cannot normally fly, including extinct flightless birds.
questions.scope: Named examples and standard alternative names count. This is a finite curated inventory, not an exhaustive list of every real-world possibility.

questions.prompt: Name a category of motor vehicle.
questions.scope: Types of self-propelled road or off-road vehicle count, with wheels, tracks or skids, including electric versions. Individual named models, rail vehicles, unpowered trailers and descriptions of condition alone do not.

questions.prompt: Name a player who has played for the Atlanta Hawks.
questions.scope: At least one first-team NBA, BAA or ABA game for this franchise counts, past or present. Coaches, draft rights and preseason-only appearances do not. Earlier NBA seasons as the Tri-Cities Blackhawks, Milwaukee Hawks and St. Louis Hawks count.

questions.prompt: Name a chemical element used in everyday products.
questions.scope: There must be a documented consumer, industrial or medical use; exact product names are not required.
